name: Asari Honoka
source:
She loves dogs, especially Shiba Inu.  She used to own a Shibu Inu.

Academics and friendship doesn't interest her. Yamato is the only friend she has.

She is quiet and doesn't show much emotion, but she loves to fight. She learned karate in elementary school, but has now been disqualified from participating in competitions.
